evidence.method: agent-prepared: pin numbers/names and pad multiset diffed against the installed KiCad 10.0.6 symbol and footprint files; no datasheet read
evidence.notes: Scope: pad count, pad numbers and symbol pin numbers only. Pin numbering row-wise (Odd_Even) matches the footprint's pad order by number; physical positions not compared.

polarity.pin1: pin 1 = square pad; odd pins on one row, even pins on the other (row-wise numbering 1,2 / 3,4 ...)

notes: Reflex J17 ESP32 SPARE. 2.54 mm headers only: no 2.0 mm header is used by any fixture. Standard 0.64 mm square pin against KiCad drill 1.0: diagonal 0.905 + 0.2 margin = 1.105 > 1.0, so the spec's PR-HOLE margin rule would flag it; the real clearance is 0.1 mm per side, which is normal for headers.
